paite: Huan Joshua in Israel nam tengteng Shekem ah asam-khawm a, Israel upate, a-intekpente, avaihawmte leh aheutute uh asamsak a; Pathian ma ah ahong kimusak chiat uhi.
heading: Joshua In Shekem Ah Mipite Kiang Ah Thu Agen
english: Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, for their heads, for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

paite: Joshua in mi tengteng kiang ah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: Na pipute uh nidanglai in lui khen lam ah ateng ua, Abraham pa leh Nahor pa Terah hialte leng, amaute'n pathian dangte nna asem uhi.
english: Joshua said to all the people, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Your fathers lived of old time beyond the River, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor. They served other gods.

paite: Na pu uh Abraham huai lui gal a pan ka pikhia a, Kanaan gam teng tawnsuak in ka pi a, asuante ka pungsak a, Isak ka pia hi.
english: I took your father Abraham from beyond the River, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his offspring, and gave him Isaac.

paite: Isak kiang ah Jakob leh Esau ka pia a; Esau tantuam ding in Seir tang ka pia a; Jakob leh atate Aigupta ah apaisuk uhi.
english: I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau Mount Seir, to possess it. Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.

paite: Mosi leh Aaron ka sawl a, alak ua thillamdang hih in Aigupta ka gawt a: huai khit in amaute ka hon pikhia hi.
english: “‘I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.

paite: Na pipute uh Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhia a, tuipi na hong tung ua; Aigupta mite'n na pipute uh kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite toh Tuipi San tan in anungdelh uhi.
english: I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and you came to the sea. The Egyptians pursued your fathers with chariots and with horsemen to the Red Sea.

paite: Amau TOUPA asam ua, Aigupta mite toh na kikal uh amialsak bikbek a, amaute tuipi tuamsak in akhuhkhumsak a; Aigupta gam a ka thilhih na mit un amu a; gamdai ah sawtpi na teng uhi.
english: When they cried out to Yahweh, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea on them, and covered them; and your eyes saw what I did in Egypt. You lived in the wilderness many days.

paite: Jordan lui gal a om Amorte gam ah ka hon pi a; amau ahon dou uh. Na khut uah amaute ka hon pia a, agam uh na luahta uhi. Amau ka hon hihmangsakta hi.
english: “‘I brought you into the land of the Amorites, that lived beyond the Jordan. They fought with you, and I gave them into your hand. You possessed their land, and I destroyed them from before you.

paite: Moab kumpipa Zippor tapa Balak ahong kisa a, Israel adou a; Beor tapa Balaam nou hon hamsiat ding in asamsak hi.
english: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel. He sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you,

paite: Himahleh Balaam thu ka ngaikhe kei hi. Huaiziak in nou ahon vualzawl zosopta hi. Huchi in akhut a pan ka hon hunkheta hi,
english: but I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he blessed you still. So I delivered you out of his hand.

paite: Jordan lui na kan ua, Jeriko khua na tungtou ua; Jeriko khomite'n hon na dou ua, Amorte, Perizte, Kanaante, Hitte, Girgaste, Hivte leh Jebuste toh; amau na khut uah ka hon peta hi.
english: “‘You went over the Jordan, and came to Jericho. The men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I delivered them into your hand.

paite: Na ma uah tunpi ka sawl a, huai in na ma uah amau adelh a, Amorte' kumpipa nihte tan in leng. Himahleh na namsau un hiam, na thal un hiam in ahi kei hi.
english: I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; not with your sword, nor with your bow.

paite: "Na sepkhiak het louh uh gam leh na bawl het louh uh khopite ka hon pia a, huaite ah na teng ua; na suan louh uh grephuan leh olive huan a pan na ne uhi.
english: I gave you a land on which you had not labored, and cities which you didn’t build, and you live in them. You eat of vineyards and olive groves which you didn’t plant.’

paite: "Huaiziak in TOUPA laudan siam unla, chitak leh thutak in ama nna sem un. Na pipute un Lui gal leh Aigupta gam a, a-nna asep uh pathiante koihkhia unla; TOUPA nna sem un.
english: “Now therefore fear Yahweh, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, in Egypt; and serve Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA nna sep hoih lou a na theih uleh tuni in kua nna ahia na sep ding uh, tel un. Na pipute un Lui gal a, a-nna asep uh pathiante hia, na luah uh gam a Amorte pathiante? Kei leh inkuante'n zaw TOUPA nna ahi ka sep ding uh," achi hi.
english: If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahweh.”

paite: Mipite'n, "TOUPA Pathian paisan a, pathian dangte nna ka sep louh ding dan uh.
english: The people answered, “Far be it from us that we should forsake Yahweh, to serve other gods;

paite: TOUPA i Pathian ngei ahi, i pipute toh Aigupta gam saltanna inn a pan hon pikhia a, i mitmuh a chiamtehna thupi taktak hih a, i paina teng leh mipi tengteng i nawk paisuakna ah leng hon vengbit hi.
english: for it is Yahweh our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way in which we went, and among all the peoples through the middle of whom we passed.

paite: TOUPA'N i ma ngei uah mi chih, huai gam a om Amorte ngei adelhkhe vek hi. Huaiziak in kou leng TOUPA nna ahi ka sep ding uh; amah lah ka Pathian uh ahi ngal a," chi in adawng uhi.
english: Yahweh drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land. Therefore we also will serve Yahweh; for he is our God.”

paite: Joshua in mipite kiang ah, "TOUPA nna ná sem thei kei ding uh. Amah lah Pathian siangthou ahi ngal a. Mullit hat Pathian ahi a; na tatleknate uh leh na khelhnate uh angaidam kei ding hi.
english: Joshua said to the people, “You can’t serve Yahweh, for he is a holy God. He is a jealous God. He will not forgive your disobedience nor your sins.

paite: TOUPA na paisan ua, namdang pathiante nna na sep uleh, na tung ua thil hoih ahih khit nung in ahong kihei dia, hon hih na in ahon hihmangthang ding," achi hi.
english: If you forsake Yahweh, and serve foreign gods, then he will turn and do you evil, and consume you, after he has done you good.”

paite: Mipite'n, Joshua kiang ah, "Hilou e, TOUPA nna ka sem kinken zaw ding uh," achi uhi.
english: The people said to Joshua, “No, but we will serve Yahweh.”

paite: Joshua in mipite kiang ah, "A- nna sep tum in TOUPA na telta uh, chih atheihpihtute noumau mah na hi uh," achi hi. Amau, "Theihpihtute ka hí uh,” achi uhi.
english: Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen Yahweh yourselves, to serve him.” They said, “We are witnesses.”

paite: Amah mah in, "Huchi ahihleh na lak ua namdang pathian omte koihmang unla, na lungtangte uh TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian lam ah awnsak un," achi hi.
english: “Now therefore put away the foreign gods which are among you, and incline your heart to Yahweh, the God of Israel.”

paite: Mipite'n Joshua kiang ah, "TOUPA i Pathian nna ka sem ding ua, athu ka zui ding uh," achi uhi.
english: The people said to Joshua, “We will serve Yahweh our God, and we will listen to his voice.”

paite: Huai ni in Joshua in mipite toh kikal ah thu akhung a, Shekem ah dan thuseh leh thuseh asehsak hi.
english: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made for them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

paite: Joshua in hiai thu Pathian Dan Laibu ah agelh a; suang lianpi ala a, TOUPA Mun Siangthou chin a tosaw nuai ah aphut hi.
english: Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God; and he took a great stone, and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of Yahweh.

paite: Joshua in mipi tengteng kiang ah, "Ngai un, hiai suang i thu hon theihpihtu hi hen. TOUPA'N i kiang ua thu agen tengteng aza vekta hi. Huaiziak in na thu uh hon theihpihtu ahi ding hi, huchi lou in zaw Pathian na kitheihmohbawl kha ding uh," achi hi.
english: Joshua said to all the people, “Behold, this stone shall be a witness against us, for it has heard all Yahweh’s words which he spoke to us. It shall be therefore a witness against you, lest you deny your God.”

paite: Huchi in Joshua in mipite atantuam gam chiat uah apaisakta hi.
english: So Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai thilte khit in Nun tapa Joshua, TOUPA sikha kum za-le-sawmkhat a upa ahih in asita hi.
heading: Joshua Leh Eleazar Sihna
english: After these things, Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Yahweh, died, being one hundred ten years old.

paite: Gaash tang mallam pang, Ephraim tanggam a amah tantuam gamgi sung Timnath-serah ah avuita uhi.
english: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.

paite: Joshua damsung leh amah khup a dam, TOUPA'N Israelte a dia thil ahih tengteng theihpih mite damsung in Israelte'n TOUPA nna asem uhi.
english: Israel served Yahweh all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, and had known all the work of Yahweh, that he had worked for Israel.

paite: Israel suante'n Aigupta gam a pan Joseph guhte apuaktouh uh Shekem a Shekem pa Hamor tapate a pan Jakob in dangka zakhat a aleina mun ah avui ua; huai mun Joseph suante tantuam ahita hi.
english: They buried the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. They became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

paite: Huan Aaron tapa Eleazar asi a; atapa Phinehas tantuam dia apiak Ephraim tang ah avui uhi.
english: Eleazar the son of Aaron died. They buried him in the hill of Phinehas his son, which was given him in the hill country of Ephraim.
